name: Ard Éireann

attributes.attribute: a peak in the Slieve Bloom mountains of central Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ard Éireann is an Irish mythological site. It is a peak in the Slieve Bloom mountains of central Ireland. The name means height of Ireland. This peak is not the highest point in the land. Myth marks its summit as the birthplace of the island of Ireland.
objective: Record Ard Éireann, a peak seen as the mythic birthplace of Ireland.
key_results: Show its place in the Slieve Bloom mountains.
Show the meaning height of Ireland and the birthplace.
